# KB response fixtures (synthetic)

These files follow the **format** of the official KB Open API sample responses
(envelope, field names, zero-padded integers, space-padded `_pN` decimals, `SC`
success flag), but all **values are synthetic**. Official samples and real quotes
are not committed because KB terms (Art. 5(3)) forbid redistributing quote data.

To test against the official samples on your own PC, download the spec JSON from
the KB portal and put the files in `tests/local_kb_samples/` (git-ignored).
